maddeler.e:
أتضاءل (form VI)
# أَتَضَاءَلُ (ʔataḍāʔalu) /ʔa.ta.dˤaː.ʔa.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَضَاءَلَ (taḍāʔala)
# أَتَضَاءَلَ (ʔataḍāʔala) /ʔa.ta.dˤaː.ʔa.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَضَاءَلَ (taḍāʔala)
# أَتَضَاءَلْ (ʔataḍāʔal) /ʔa.ta.dˤaː.ʔal/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَضَاءَلَ (taḍāʔala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
